vulnerability_analysis: The Uniswap V2 Router is vulnerable to reordering attacks (sandwich attacks) due to the public mempool and price impact of large swaps. An attacker can monitor pending swap transactions and strategically place their own swaps before and after to profit from the price movement.
attack_strategy: Implement a sandwich attack: 1) Front-run victim's large buy with a smaller buy, 2) Let victim's transaction execute (moves price up), 3) Back-run by selling tokens at higher price. Profit comes from buying low and selling high due to victim's price impact.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Create test tokens and WETH mock. 2. Deploy Uniswap pair and add liquidity. 3. Simulate victim preparing large swap. 4. Attacker front-runs with swapExactETHForTokens. 5. Victim executes large swap. 6. Attacker back-runs with swapExactTokensForETH. 7. Verify attacker's ETH balance increased.
